Fix `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionHistory.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. yarn test:app regression (this test passed before this run):
 FAIL  packages/excalidraw/tests/history.test.tsx > history > multiplayer undo/redo > conflicts in frames and their children > should not rebind frame child with frame when frame was remotely deleted and frame child is added back through the history 
AssertionError: expected [ { id: 'id0', …(29) }, …(1) ] to deeply equal [ ObjectContaining{…}, …(1) ]
After undo, h.elements comes back as [frame(id0), rect(id1)] but the test expects the scene array order [rect, frame]. Before this change undo/redo passed arrayToMap(elements), which iterates in scene array order; now they pass new Map(app.scene.getAllPagesElementsMapIncludingDeleted()), whose iteration order differs. The map handed to history.undo/redo must iterate the active page elements in scene array order (as arrayToMap(elements) did), followed by the elements of the other pages, so ordering on the active page is unchanged.
